name: Embers: A Session for Two
description: For two adults, together in bed. A slow, sensual guided experience of breath, skin and attention that rebuilds desire and closeness. Sensual and tasteful, not explicit. Both partners must want to take part.

segments.text: This session is for two adults who both want to be here. If either of you would rather not, say so, and stop. Nothing in this session is ever expected of you, and either of you can open your eyes or pause at any time.

Make the room yours. Dim the lights, warm the air, and silence your phones. Lie facing each other, or side by side, close enough to feel each other's warmth. Undressed, with sheets or without, whichever feels right.
For a minute, simply look at one another. Let your eyes be soft. Notice that this is a person you chose, and who chose you. Let a small smile arrive if it wants to.
Now close your eyes, and let your breathing find a shared rhythm. In together, and out together. Nothing else is required of you right now.
Let your attention drift to the sound of your own breath, and to the sound of your partner's. Two breaths in one room. Two bodies, warm in the same space.
Breathe in for four. Hold gently. And breathe out for six, slowly, as if cooling something warm. Again, in for four, and out for six.
With every out-breath, the day falls away. The work, the worries, the lists. Let all of it drain into the mattress beneath you.
Your body is heavy and soft. Your shoulders are loose, your jaw is easy, your hands are open. You are arriving, fully, in your own skin.
And notice that arriving in your own body is the first step toward meeting another. Let that thought settle.
Feel your skin as a whole. The air touching it. The sheets or the warmth. Everything you feel is simply sensation, and all of it can be enjoyed.
I will count down from ten. With each number, you sink deeper into your senses, and further from thinking. Ten. Nine. Eight.
Seven. Six. Feel the weight of your body, warm and relaxed. Five. Four. Three, deeper into the feeling of being here.
Two. One. Fully present, fully here, in your body and in this room.
Now notice three things you can hear. Perhaps your partner's breathing, the room, the quiet between. Notice three things you can feel on your skin.
Notice two scents, perhaps clean linen, perhaps the warmth of skin. And one taste, or the simple feel of your mouth, soft and relaxed.
Every sense is gently awake, and everything else has gone quiet. This is the state in which desire grows, with no effort, as naturally as warmth spreads.
In this state, there is no need to perform. There is only attention, and attention is the most attractive thing you can give.
Imagine a warm light glowing low in your belly, like an ember beneath ash. Each breath in is a soft breath on that ember. Each breath out lets the warmth spread a little further.
Feel the warmth move through your hips and your thighs, up through your chest, down through your arms to your fingertips, until your whole body hums quietly.
Your skin is becoming more alive. Every touch, however light, will feel richer, deeper and more welcome. You are becoming more sensitive and more responsive, in the most pleasurable way.

Now, when you are ready, and only when you are both ready, let your eyes stay closed and reach for each other. Let one hand find a hand, or a shoulder, or a cheek. Take your time. Touch slowly, as though you were meeting this body for the first time.
Notice the warmth of your partner's skin. Notice how it feels to be touched with attention, without hurry or goal. Slow is a gift. Let it be slow.
I find my partner deeply attractive. I notice the details I love: the curve of a shoulder, the warmth of a neck, the way their breath changes when I touch them.
I am present in my body, and my body is welcome here. I do not judge it. I let it feel, and I let it be seen. I am wanted, and I am wanting.
My desire is allowed to rise slowly. I let it build in its own time, like the tide, and I enjoy every part of the rising. Anticipation is itself a pleasure.
I listen as much as I touch. I notice what my partner enjoys, and I offer them that gladly. I say what I like, in words or in touch, and I trust that it will be welcomed.
Between us there is trust and playfulness. We can laugh, we can be quiet, we can change our minds. Nothing is rushed. Everything is chosen.
Each time we come together like this, our connection deepens. Our attraction grows richer. We feel more like lovers than we have in a long time.
Stay in this feeling now, in whatever way suits you both. I will be quiet for a little while. Breathe, touch, look, explore, and let the warmth guide you, together.
In a moment, the guided part of this session will end, and you can carry on exactly as you wish. Slow down, or speed up, or simply hold each other.
I will count up from one to five. At five you will be fully awake and present, and the warmth and closeness will stay with you.
One, returning. Two, aware of the room, the warmth of each other. Three, energy flowing back. Four, breath deepening.
Five, eyes open if you wish, or keep them closed a little longer. Look at each other, and smile. Welcome back. The rest of the night is yours.
